'''Grace''' was a spiritual concept, likely native to [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]], which required its adherents to demonstrate certain virtues. Grace could be lost or gained; [[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Kardue'sai'Malloc]], a believer in Grace, claimed to gain grace through displays of patience and restraint and to lose it during a period of dissoluteness and despondence. He also claimed that [[Wuher/Legends|Wuher's]] hatred of the universe had a spiritual purity approaching Grace but that his love of money kept him from achieving it.
